params.name: target_db
params.description: Target KEGG database. Supported: pathway, brite, module, ko, genes, genome, compound, glycan, reaction, rclass, enzyme, disease, drug, dgroup, network, variant, and organism codes.

params.name: source_db
params.description: Source KEGG database or organism code.

items.docs: Find related entries between two KEGG databases using cross-references. Returns tab-delimited text listing relationships between entries in the source and target databases.

params.name: dbentries
params.description: One or more source entry identifiers separated by plus signs. Maximum 10 entries per request.

items.docs: Find related entries in a target KEGG database for specific source entries. Returns tab-delimited cross-reference relationships. Up to 10 entries per request. RDF output formats (turtle, n-triple) are also supported via the option parameter.
